entry.title: Build with AI 2026: 開發者與 Token 經濟學
entry.summary: Join GDG Cloud Hong Kong for an exclusive pre-event to Google Cloud AI Live + Labs 2026, featuring talks on Generative AI and Developer Economics. Connect with Google Cloud experts, dive into AI token strategies, and network with the tech community. The event takes place on September 14, 2026, at the Google Hong Kong Office, catering to tech enthusiasts and developers. RSVP by September 11.
entry.content:
*** All sessions are in PuTongHua, English and CANTONESE (zh-yue-Hant-HK) ***

*** 此活動主要以普通話，英語 及 廣東話(粵語)進行 ***

☁️ Developers and Token Economics Talk

Google Cloud AI Live + Labs Hong Kong 2026 Pre-Event Session

On the eve of Google Cloud AI Live + Labs Hong Kong 2026, GDG Cloud Hong Kong warmly invites you to an exclusive evening of deep-tech talks and high-value networking focused on Generative AI and Developer Economics on Google Cloud!

Visiting Developer Advocates from Google Cloud will share behind-the-scenes insights from Cloud Next and real-world strategies on balancing AI capabilities with Token Economics. Don't miss this opportunity to connect directly with Googlers and the local tech ecosystem.

在 Google Cloud AI Live + Labs Hong Kong 2026 前夕，GDG Cloud Hong Kong 誠邀你參與「開發者與 Token 經濟學」交流之夜！來自 Google Cloud 的 Developer Advocate 將親臨香港，除了分享 Cloud Next 的最新生成式 AI 幕後技術外，更會深度解析開發者在構建 AI 應用時必須掌握的 Token 經濟學與架構實戰。

💡 Key Takeaways | 活動亮點

  • Deep Dive into AI Economics: 理解 LLM 時代下的 Token 成本架構、優化策略與效能平衡。

  • Cloud Next Behind-the-Scenes: 搶先了解 Google Cloud 最新 GenAI 應用的落地實踐與幕後秘辛。

  • Direct Google Networking: 與 Google 專家近距離 AMA 交流，並與本地開發者社群拓展人脈。

🎤 Featured Speaker & Topic | 嘉賓講者與主題

  • Topic: 開發者與 Token 經濟學 (Developers and Token Economics)

  • Speaker: Edward Chuang – Developer Relations Engineer, Google Cloud

📅 Event Details | 活動詳情

  • Date | 日期: September 14, 2026 (Monday)

  • Time | 時間: 7:00 PM – 9:00 PM (Check-in & Networking starts at 6:45 PM)

  • Venue | 地點: Google Hong Kong Office

  • Venue Sponsor | 場地贊助: Google

🗓️ Agenda | 活動流程

Time Session內容
6:45 PM - 7:30 PM Check-in & Networking with Refreshment簽到、交流及茶歇
7:30 PM - 7:40 PM Opening & IntroductionGDG Cloud HK 開場致辭 (by Leonardo Lee)
7:40 PM - 7:45 PM Group Photo大合照
7:45 PM - 8:30 PM Developers and Token Economics主題分享：開發者與 Token 經濟學 (by Edward Chuang)
8:30 PM - 9:00 PM Ask Me Anything (AMA) & Q&A互動問答與交流 (by Edward Chuang)
9:00 PM Closing活動結束

🚨 Application Deadline | 報名截止日期: September 11, 2026 (11:59 PM)
👉 RSVP Now | 立即報名

entry.title: Eco-AI Hackathon: Unleash Creativity with Live Data and Art
entry.summary: Join the GDG Hong Kong Eco-AI Hackathon to create interactive ecological art using real-time data and responsible AI. Developers, designers, and tech enthusiasts will explore AI's role in reimagining nature. Top projects might be showcased at the Jockey Club Museum of Climate Change during the "Rootelligence" exhibition. Register by September 10, 2026, for this event on September 19-20 at CUHK.
entry.content:
參加由 GDG Hong Kong 協辦嘅 2 天 Eco-AI Hackathon，運用即時數據與負責任 AI 構建互動生態藝術原型，優秀作品更有機會喺賽馬會氣候變化博物館實體展出！

活動簡介 / Event Overview

我哋誠意邀請你參加由 GDG Hong Kong 夥拍 Digital Common(s)、Gerry Li Studio 及 Nexamind AI 聯手舉辦嘅 Eco-AI Hackathon: Live Data Visuals & Interactive Ecological Art！

想唔想自己設計嘅 AI 互動藝術作品喺博物館展出？今次 Hackathon 為賽馬會氣候變化博物館「Rootelligence」展覽（2026年8月29日至10月31日）嘅特別項目。我哋將會帶領大家運用即時數據視覺化（Live Data Visuals）、負責任 AI (Responsible AI) 同 Vibe Coding 快速構建原型，重新探索自然世界同氣候議題。優勝團隊更有機會將作品於賽馬會氣候變化博物館實體展出！有興趣就記得喺 9 月 10 日前報名喇！

賽道劃分與亮點 / Tracks & Key Highlights

組別賽道 (Tracks)

  • Track A： 大專學生組（18–25 歲）

  • Track B： 公開組（26–35 歲）

活動重點 (Key Focus Areas)

  • 非人類視角構思： 透過即時數據將生態訊號轉化為視覺體驗，以全新視角重新想像自然。

  • 負責任 AI 與 Vibe Coding： 運用快速 AI 協同開發原型，同時遵循負責任 AI 準則。

  • 探討 AI 碳足跡： 深入了解並評估生成式 AI 對環境嘅影響同能源消耗。

  • 博物館展出機會： 獲得專業導師指導，優勝作品有機會於賽馬會氣候變化博物館實體展出。

導師及嘉賓 / Mentors & Facilitators

  • Gerry Li (Gerry Li Studio)

  • Frankie Wu

  • Ambrose Yuen

  • Dr. Provides Ng

目標對象與準備事項 / Target Audience & Prerequisites

  • 對象： 適合具備中等技術水平（Medium Level）嘅開發者、設計師、數位藝術家及科技愛好者。

  • 準備事項： 為咗參與實作與開發環節，請自備手提電腦及充電器。

活動詳情 / Event Details

  • 日期： 2026年9月19日–20日 (星期六、日)

  • 時間： 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM HKT

  • 地點： 香港中文大學 (CUHK) — 具體地點將於成功報名後發送

  • 展覽夥伴： 賽馬會氣候變化博物館（「Rootelligence 根智」展覽）

  • 報名截止日期： 2026年9月10日

  • 報名連結： 即刻報名 **不要在Event Page報名！**

=== 特別鳴謝合作夥伴 Digital Common(s)、Gerry Li Studio 及 Nexamind AI ===

We cordially invite you to the Eco-AI Hackathon: Live Data Visuals & Interactive Ecological Art, supported by GDG Hong Kong, Digital Common(s), Gerry Li Studio, and Nexamind AI!

Held as part of the featured "Rootelligence" exhibition at the Jockey Club Museum of Climate Change (Aug 29 – Oct 31, 2026), this two-day hackathon brings together developers, designers, and creative technologists to bridge artificial intelligence, real-time data visualization, and ecological art. Participants will explore how AI can reimagine nature through non-human perspectives, deploy responsible AI using rapid "vibe coding" practices, and evaluate the environmental impact and computational footprint of modern AI models. Top prototypes will earn the opportunity to showcase their work live at the museum!

Hackathon Tracks & Highlights

Tracks

  • Track A: University Students (Aged 18–25)

  • Track B: Open Track (Aged 26–35)

Key Focus Areas & Takeaways

  • Reimagine Nature: Translate complex, real-time ecological datasets into creative visuals through non-human perspectives.

  • Responsible AI & Vibe Coding: Harness rapid AI-assisted development responsibly to turn concepts into interactive prototypes.

  • Environmental Impact of AI: Gain critical insights into measuring and mitigating the computational carbon footprint of AI models.

  • Museum Showcase Opportunity: Top prototypes will get the opportunity to have their work exhibited live at the Jockey Club Museum of Climate Change during the "Rootelligence" exhibition.

Mentors & Facilitators

  • Gerry Li (Gerry Li Studio)

  • Frankie Wu

  • Ambrose Yuen

  • Dr. Provides Ng

Target Audience & Prerequisites

  • Skill Level: Medium / Intermediate (Basic experience with coding, creative technology, data visualization, or AI API integration recommended).

  • Who Should Join: Developers, designers, creative coders, and tech enthusiasts passionate about AI, digital art, and environmental sustainability.

  • Prerequisites: Please bring your own laptop and charger for the hands-on building sessions.

Event Details

  • Date: September 19–20, 2026 (Saturday & Sunday)

  • Time: 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM HKT

  • Venue: The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) — Exact venue details shared post-registration

  • Exhibition Partner: Jockey Club Museum of Climate Change ("Rootelligence" Exhibition)

  • Registration Deadline: September 10, 2026

  • Registration Link: Register Here **DO NOT REGISTER THROUGH THIS EVENT PAGE!**
